Choose elements for what content *is* — <nav>, <main>, <article>, <button>, <ul> — rather than wrapping everything in <div>. Semantic markup is self-documenting, accessible by default, and better for SEO. 'Div soup' is valid but throws away free structure and meaning.

Start every document with <!DOCTYPE html> so the browser uses standards mode instead of quirks mode, and set <html lang="en"> (or the correct language) so screen readers pronounce content correctly and translation tools work. Missing or wrong lang is one of the most common, easily-fixed accessibility failures.
